## Summary

Added /dashboard/admin/integrations: a server page gated by requireAnyPermission(['integrations.manage','documents.manage']), a client IntegrationsView with a copyable Service Account banner plus Drive Roots and Linked Calendars tabs, and two dialogs (DriveRootDialog, CalendarDialog). Added six server actions to features/admin/actions.ts (getAdminIntegrationsData, saveDriveRootAction, deleteDriveRootAction, saveGoogleCalendarAction, deleteGoogleCalendarAction, triggerSyncAction), new item types, requireAnyPermission(), one icon, and the Administration nav entry. No migration: consumes the PSI-061 M6 schema as-is. Sync buttons call triggerSyncAction, which posts to Edge Functions owned by PSI-062/065/066 and currently no-ops gracefully since those are not deployed.

## Decisions

- **Gate the page with requireAnyPermission(['integrations.manage','documents.manage']) and re-check integrations.manage inside every mutating action**: The page shows data readable by either permission, but only integrations.manage may mutate. UI hiding is not authorization, so each server action enforces its own check.
- **Accept a full Google Drive URL in the root dialog and extract the folder id server-side**: An operator copies the URL from their browser; requiring them to hand-pick the id is an avoidable error source.
- **Make triggerSyncAction swallow Edge Function failures and report a queued job**: The sync functions belong to PSI-062/065/066 and are not deployed yet, so a hard error would make the whole page look broken. Flagged as a follow-up to revisit once PSI-062 lands.
- **Join drive_root_access to roles/groups in memory rather than via a nested PostgREST select**: Keeps the action readable and typed against the generated database types; the row counts here are small.
